2: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
3: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
4: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
5: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
6: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.
7: The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.
8: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
9: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
10: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
11: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
12: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
13: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
14: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me! Lift me up from the gates of death,
15: that I may declare all Your praises— that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
16: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
17: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah
18: The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.
19: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.
20: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
21: Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah
